Maya R.: Heads up — since 2025-09-10 15:07 UTC I'm seeing recurrent p99 spikes on shared-gpu pool A when serving llama-70b-q4 variants. Tail up to 1.8s, baseline ~180ms. Looks like noisy-tenant effect; other tenants on same node show throughput drop.
Kenji T.: Seen it too. Timeline: spike started ~15:07, repeated every ~2–3m for 20m. Perf profiler shows kernel switch to generic matmul kernel at some steps.
Sara P.: Any infra changes/deploys around then? autoscaler? quotas?
OpsBot: Auto-scaling event: added node pool A-2 at 15:06:22 UTC. Rolling upgrade: inference-runtime v1.22.1 -> v1.23.0 at 15:05:58 UTC.
Maya R.: Correlated with deploy. Profiling snapshot (sampled traces):
```
[trace id=tr-9a2e] kernel_select: chosen=matmul_generic, reason=shape_mismatch
batch_window_ms: 2 -> 0.5
kv_cache_evictions: 94/s
GPU_util: 96% on host xg-42
```
Niels: The matmul_generic selection is suspicious, likely fallback due to sequence-length histogram change — maybe batching heuristics shrank due to many 1-3 token calls from tenant B.
Kenji T.: I dug deeper — tenant B had many small streaming requests after a spike in traffic; continuous batching saw tiny windows and the kernel selector preferred safety kernel causing 3x token latency.
Carmen L.: Is KV cache being evicted per-tenant? eviction rate 94/s seems high. Could be thrash from multiple tenants using ephemeral contexts.
Sara P.: Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) pin problematic tenant to a lower weight class, 2) enforce per-tenant max concurrent inflight=20, 3) enable kernel-selector strict-mode to prefer faster quantized kernels if safe.
Maya R.: I applied per-tenant inflight limit (tenant:B -> 18) at 15:20 UTC and throttled streaming window. Results: p99 down to 260ms within 8 minutes. Confirmed reduced kv evictions to 12/s.
Kenji T.: Good. Follow-ups: add per-tenant GPU memory soft caps, add metric for 'kernel_fallback_rate', and a canary test that pulses many small requests to ensure batching heuristics don't collapse.
Niels: Also file a perf regression PR to pin kernel-selector commit prior to v1.23.0 change that loosened shape checks.
Maya R.: Created ticket INF-4723 with traces + flamegraphs: https://redwood.app/infra/INF-4723 :thumbsup: 
Carmen L.: I'll propose an SLA-friendly fairness policy in next hours, incl. smoothing of streaming bursts. Thanks everyone!
